manifest.name: dsh-tokstats
manifest.description: 可能有用的 DSH token 用量插件，跨会话统计 token 都花在哪儿了：用量总览四项指标、上下文长度分布、近 12 周热力图与按周趋势，工作区与模型排行；另附有发送前 token 预告和输入草稿优化功能。
manifest.author: PlusQi

bundle.text:
# dsh-tokstats bundle patch: one row per plugin in this pack.
#
# Row names are a two-tier scheme, and the reason is the host's ONLY per-row
# display-text channel. `dsh-plugin-manager` builds each row as
# `meta = pluginPackages.metaOf(row.name, base)` -> `dsh-app-boot`
# `readPluginMeta(specifier)`, which reads `${specifier}/locale/en.json`
# (`meta.title` / `meta.description`). The row's `name` is therefore BOTH the
# Loader module specifier and the display-text key - there is no separate
# `row.label` (the manager only projects `{ rowId, moduleName, entryId, meta }`).
#
#   - 'dsh-tokstats'          <- bare package name: the CLIENT ANCHOR. Only a
#                                bare name enters the browser module graph
#                                (`dsh-client-modules` `exactPackageSpecifier`
#                                rejects any specifier containing '/'), so
#                                exactly ONE row must keep it or the whole
#                                client half disappears silently. It reads the
#                                package-level locale/ (the pack's own copy),
#                                which the bundle card on the same page shares -
#                                so that title names THIS component (tokstats)
#                                rather than the pack, and the bundle card
#                                follows it. Splitting the two needs separate
#                                packages; the host has no row.label channel.
#   - 'dsh-tokstats/<plugin>' <- subpath rows: each reads its own
#                                locale/<plugin>/{en,zh}.json, so every
#                                component shows its own title and description
#                                instead of three identical lines. These rows
#                                are host-only; the subpaths live in exports
#                                and resolve to the same lib/index.js, and
#                                config.plugin still dispatches.
#
# Consequence of the anchor (documented in docs/INVARIANTS.md PK-01): the
# client half stays loaded while ANY row is live, but the anchor row owns the
# bare name - disabling the tokstats row drops the bare-name row, which
# unloads the client graph and with it BOTH tokprev and promptopt UI. Disabling
# the subpath rows only removes their own host fiber. Per-plugin client
# off-switches still need a separate package.
#
# Rows are host fibers only - the client boot manifest creates ONE entry per
# package with no config, so lib/client.js applies ALL plugins unconditionally
# and config.plugin is a host-plane dispatch key. Row ids are pack-scoped and
# prefixed to never collide with dsh-base / dsh-web-app builtin ids (patch
# layers override by id).
- insert:
    # 组件行顺序 = 插件页「包含的组件」的展示顺序（宿主按 patch 的 insert 顺序 flatten，
    # 没有排序字段）。打头的是包的主线组件 tokstats，它同时是裸包名锚点行。
    #
    # tokstats: 侧栏列表项 + root `main` 全局面板（hook 已占 sidebar.footer.action，
    # 全局面板的正路是 main keyed slot + ctx.layout.selectPanel）。host 半边注册一个
    # per-session 投影单元：折叠结果由官方 session-projection-cache 持久化，本包不再
    # 写任何自有存储文件。**裸包名行（client 锚点），不要改成子路径。**
    #   展示文案：读包级 locale/{zh,en}.json。因为裸包名只有这一条通道，包级那份文案
    #   就是「插件页顶部的包卡片」与「本行」共用的同一份——标题写的是本组件名
    #   （Token 用量统计），描述写的是 tokstats 这一组件的功能；包卡片因此也不再是
    #   「三个组件的总称」。想分开只能拆包（宿主没有 row.label 通道，见 PK-01）。
    #   windowDays: 折叠窗口天数（缺省 90）。超过窗口的明细被折进 epoch 合计，
    #               读取期排除并改计 epoch，原始明细不删（面板的「全部」档位仍可查）。
    - id: tokstats
      name: 'dsh-tokstats'
      config:
        plugin: tokstats
        windowDays: 90
    # tokprev: composer 下一轮 token 预告行（子路径行，读 locale/tokprev/）
    - id: tokprev
      name: 'dsh-tokstats/tokprev'
      config:
        plugin: tokprev
    # promptopt: composer dock 的「优化提示词」按钮 + 原文/优化文对照弹层（子路径行，
    # 读 locale/promptopt/）。宿主半边注册 RPC 通道 /dsh-plugins.promptopt（历史名，
    # 不随包名变），走 ctx.llm 做一次旁路模型调用（骑已注册的第一个 provider/model
    # 路由，无配置面）。通道随本行 fiber 卸载即摘，禁用本行即整链路下线。
    - id: promptopt
      name: 'dsh-tokstats/promptopt'
      config:
        plugin: promptopt

readme.text:
可能有用的 [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) token 用量插件 **dsh-tokstats**：告诉你 token 花在哪了，内含三个组件。

| 组件 | 有什么用 | 在哪看到 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **tokstats** | 跨会话统计 token 都花在哪儿了：用量总览四项指标、上下文长度分布、近 12 周热力图与按周趋势，外加工作区与模型排行 | 侧栏「Token 用量统计」→ 全局面板 |
| **tokprev** | 发送前告诉你这一轮大概要喂多少 token | 输入框底部一行灰色小字 |
| **promptopt** | 把口语草稿整理成结构化提示词 | 输入框下方工具栏右端的星标按钮 |

装法见下文[安装](#安装)。
看看 token 花了多少，谁花得多？侧栏「Token 用量统计」进入全局面板——顶部四张指标卡就是**用量总览**，中间是每日调用量与近 12 周热力图，下面是上下文长度分布、按周趋势、工作区与模型排行，最后一块是提示词整理的使用情况。

| 区块 | 它回答什么 |
| --- | --- |
| **四张指标卡** | **所选区间**用了多少？缓存省了多少？（跟档位走，切档即变） |
| **每日调用量** | 这几天里哪一天用得凶？窗口跟档位走（最短 7 天；卡头写着实际跨度），超 30 列按整日合并；与热力图并排，日期刻度对齐每根柱 |
| **近 12 周用量** | 哪些天在用、哪些天断档？点某天只看那一天 |
| **上下文长度分布** | 请求有多长？长请求占多大比例？按计费输入分 6 桶：`[0,8K)` / `[8K,32K)` / `[32K,128K)` / `[128K,256K)` / `[256K,512K)` / `[512K,∞)` |
| **趋势（按周）** | 这周比上周多还是少？每周一条比例条，本周标「进行中」并置灰（还没过完）；周合计恒等于总计 |
| **模型排行** | 用量集中在哪个模型？按 `provider/model` 组合计，拿不到路由的归「未标注」排最后，各行之和等于总计 |
| **工作区排行** | 用量集中在哪个项目？可下拉切到单个工作区，子会话归并到根工作区 |
| **提示词整理使用情况** | promptopt 真被用上了吗？发起 / 采纳 / 放弃计数与采纳率 |
时间窗五档：**当日** / 近 7 天 / 本月 / 近 30 天 / 全部，默认**当日**——档位决定四张指标卡与分布 / 排行 / 周趋势的口径，切换即重算。热力图恒为近 12 周、不跟档位走；日柱图的窗口跟档位走、但最短 7 天（当日档也画 7 根柱，超 30 列按整日合并），卡头写着实际跨度。

readme.section: tokprev：发送前，先算这一轮要花多少
readme.text:
官方 ContextMeter 已经给了上下文长度，它没说的是**你正在输入框里敲的这段草稿还要额外花掉多少**。tokprev 会补上这个。

> 下一轮输入 ≈ 20K · 草稿 17 · 输出预估 -

- **下一轮输入** = 当前上下文 + 草稿估算，边打字边跳；
- **草稿** = 本地按字符数估的，不发请求；
- **输出预估** = 最近几轮真实输出的区间。只统计已结束的轮次，所以新会话或当前轮还没跑完时显示 `-`（上图就是），跑完一轮就变成 `1.5K–3K` 这样的区间；
- 会话正在跑时整行隐藏；没有真实请求锚点时数字前带 `*`，表示纯估算。

readme.section: promptopt：把口语草稿优化成结构化提示词
readme.text:
把「那个登录报错你帮我看看 别动其他文件」这种草稿，**保真重排**成模型更容易解析的结构化输入。不扩写成执行计划，也不补原文没有的事实、路径、约束、步骤。

- **怎么用**：点星标按钮 → 弹层里原文与整理结果上下对照 → 满意才点**采纳**，只有采纳才写回输入框；
- **按钮置灰**（悬浮有原因）：草稿为空，或含引用 chip、图片附件、`/` 命令——写回是全量替换，重排会破坏引用坐标与图片归属；
- **采纳** 以点击那一刻的草稿快照为准，会覆盖等待期间的编辑，没有二次确认；
- 走宿主已有的模型路由，没有配置项，不新建 API key；
- 关闭、Esc、点弹层外都算取消，会中止这次调用。

前置：Node.js、git、pnpm。

```powershell
npm i -g pnpm
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:PlusQi/dsh-tokstats#v0.9.1
```

**装完必须重启宿主进程**（profile 组合只在启动时生效），再刷新页面。没有配置文件、没有 API key、没有构建步骤。

- **上面这条带 `#v0.9.1`，装的是一个固定快照**，推荐这种方式；
- 想跟最新：去掉 `#v0.9.1`，即 `add github:PlusQi/dsh-tokstats`——**这条装的是默认分支（`master`）的最新代码**，不是「最新正式版」。git 地址没有 npm 那种 `latest` 概念，任何不带 `#ref` 的写法都指向分支 HEAD。市场目录里的安装按钮用的就是这种裸地址，所以从商店装也一样是跟主线；
- 本机开发：`add link:D:\path\to\dsh-tokstats`，改完代码重启即生效；
- profile 不叫 `web` 就换成你自己的。**桌面版（Electron）不能用 CLI 装**——`desktop` profile 由应用独占，CLI 会拒绝；请在应用内的「设置 → 插件」里装。

1. 侧栏多了一项 **「Token 用量统计」**，点进去有四张指标卡；
2. 输入框底部多了一行灰色小字，打几个字，「草稿」那个数会跟着变；
3. 输入框下方那排工具栏的右端多了一个**星标按钮**（模型选择与发送按钮之间），打了草稿后可用。

三处全没有？看 [出问题了](#出问题了)。
界面文案跟随 DSH 的 **设置 → 常规 → Language**，插件本身没有语言开关。promptopt 是例外：**整理结果跟随草稿的语言**，不跟界面语言。

插件 UI 整个不见，按顺序排这几条：

1. **宿主版本对不上。** 本包钉死了实测过的宿主版本，不匹配时宿主会安静地跳过整个包（连日志都不打），表现就是「插件坏了」。跑 `dsh plugin --profile web list`，出现 `is incompatible with dsh …` 就是它；
2. **没重启宿主进程**，只刷新了浏览器；
3. **装到了别的 profile，或换了 `DSH_HOME`**；
4. **locale 服务被禁用了**，界面文案依赖它，缺席时整包不加载。

其它常见现象：

- **面板一直「统计中…」**：首次要扫一遍历史日志，几秒到十几秒正常；
- **数字比你以为的少**：先看页脚有没有「跳过 M 个（日志不可读）」，再确认当前是哪个时间档；
- **面板显示「校验中…」**：后台还在核校，屏上是缓存值，几秒后自动变准；
- **promptopt 报「模型调用失败」**：宿主没有可用模型路由，检查模型配置。
还有一处**不是故障**：市场卡片上那个「宿主要求未知」标签。本包只从 GitHub 分发、没有发布到 npm，而市场只对 registry 上的包读 `engines.dsh`——所以它拿不到本包的宿主要求，标签就停在「未知」。插件照常安装、照常运行；真正判断是否兼容的方式见上一条（`dsh plugin --profile web list`）。
```powershell
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-tokstats

npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tokstats
```

想临时关掉其中一个组件，在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 里加：

```yaml
- id: tokprev
  disabled: true
```

重启生效。注意关 `tokprev` **不会**让它从页面上消失——只要包里还有别的行活着，浏览器侧整包就仍在加载；要真正按组件独立开关，只能把这个组件拆成独立的包（见 [docs/MAINTAINING.md](./docs/MAINTAINING.md)）。
维护者与 AI Agent 从 [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) 进入；发布流程与宿主侧契约在 [docs/MAINTAINING.md](./docs/MAINTAINING.md)，不变量证据在 [docs/INVARIANTS.md](./docs/INVARIANTS.md)，变更记录在 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)。

A possibly useful [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) token usage plugin, **dsh-tokstats**: where your tokens went, in three components.

| Component | What it is for | Where you see it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **tokstats** | Cross-session stats on where your tokens went: four headline figures, context length distribution, a 12-week heatmap and weekly trend, plus workspace and model rankings | "Token usage stats" in the sidebar → a full panel |
| **tokprev** | Tells you roughly how many tokens the next turn will feed in, before you send | One grey line at the bottom of the input box |
| **promptopt** | Turns a spoken draft into a structured prompt | Star button at the right end of the toolbar under the input box |
Installation is [further down](#install).

How many tokens were spent, and who spent them? "Token usage stats" in the sidebar opens a full panel — four headline figures on top, daily calls and the 12-week heatmap in the middle, then context length distribution, the weekly trend, workspace and model rankings, and finally prompt restructure usage.

| Block | What it answers |
| --- | --- |
| **Four metric cards** | How much did the **selected window** use? How much did caching save? (Follows the window switcher) |
| **Daily calls** | Which of these days was heavy? (Window follows the switcher, never shorter than 7 days — the card header prints the actual span; beyond 30 columns days are merged; sits next to the heatmap with date ticks aligned to each bar) |
| **Last 12 weeks** | Which days were active, which were idle? Click a day to see just that day |
| **Context length distribution** | How long are my requests? How much sits in long ones? Billed input binned into six tiers: `[0,8K)` / `[8K,32K)` / `[32K,128K)` / `[128K,256K)` / `[256K,512K)` / `[512K,∞)` |
| **Trend (weekly)** | Is this week heavier than last? One bar per week; the current week is dimmed and marked "in progress"; weekly totals always add up to the grand total |
| **Models** | Which model carries the usage? Counted by `provider/model`; samples with no route land in "Unattributed" placed last, so the rows add up to the total |
| **Workspaces** | Which project carries the usage? A picker switches to a single workspace; subagent usage merges into the root work

Five windows: **today** / last 7 days / this month / last 30 days / all time, today by default — the window drives the four metric cards plus the distribution, ranking and weekly blocks. The heatmap always covers the last 12 weeks regardless of the switcher; the daily bar chart follows the switcher but is never shorter than 7 days (the today window still draws 7 bars, and beyond 30 columns days are merged), with the actual span printed in its card header.

readme.section: tokprev: count the turn before you send
readme.text:
The official ContextMeter already shows how long the context is. What it does not tell you is **how much the draft you are typing right now will add**. tokprev fills only that gap.

> Next input ≈ 20K · Draft 17 · Est. output -

readme.section: tokprev: count the turn before you send
promptopt: turn a spoken draft into a structured prompt
readme.text: Takes a draft like "the login error keeps popping up, take a look; don't touch other files" and **faithfully restructures** it into input a model parses more easily. It does not expand it into an execution plan, and it does not add facts, paths, constraints or steps the draft does not contain.

readme.section: promptopt: turn a spoken draft into a structured prompt

readme.text:
Prerequisites: Node.js, git, pnpm.

```powershell
npm i -g pnpm
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:PlusQi/dsh-tokstats#v0.9.1
```

**Restart the host process afterwards** (profile composition only happens at startup), then reload the page. No config file, no API key, no build step.

UI copy follows DSH's **Settings → General → Language**; the pack has no language switch of its own. promptopt is the exception: its **restructured result follows the draft's language**, not the UI language.

One thing that is **not** a fault: the "host requirement unknown" chip on the market card. This pack ships from GitHub only and is not published to npm, and the market reads `engines.dsh` from registry packages — so it cannot see this pack's host requirement and the chip stays unknown. The plugin installs and runs normally; for the real compatibility check see item 1 above (`dsh plugin --profile web list`).
```powershell
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-tokstats

npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tokstats
```

To temporarily disable one of the components, append to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: tokprev
  disabled: true
```

Restart to apply. Note that disabling `tokprev` does **not** remove it from the page — as long as any other row of the pack is live, the browser-side bundle still loads; a real per-component off-switch requires splitting that component into its own package (see [docs/MAINTAINING.md](./docs/MAINTAINING.md)).

Maintainers and AI agents start from [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md); the publishing flow and host-side contracts live in [docs/MAINTAINING.md](./docs/MAINTAINING.md), invariant evidence in [docs/INVARIANTS.md](./docs/INVARIANTS.md), and release history in [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md).
